scope: Access only. Fixes the recertification path that bumped a live grant's version without advancing its materialized rows, which took the service to 503 on every path for three days. No application-auth behaviour, schema, policy, catalog or credential was otherwise changed.

incident.symptom: access.w33d.xyz answered 503 on every path except /healthz; container reported unhealthy; analyze-facade went unhealthy with it
incident.root_cause: workers/due.rs open_recertification() moved grt_platform_bootstrap_admin_v7 from active to expiring with version=version+1 and re-enqueued its projection at desired_version 2, but did not advance grant_entitlement.grant_version or grant_binding.grant_version. The projection worker then read a stale expansion, failed with 'desired grant expansion is stale', exhausted 12 attempts and marked the projection dead. /readyz requires that projection to be 'projected', so the serving readiness gate returned 503 for every path.
incident.why_it_was_latent: Every other version-bump path already advances the materialization in the same transaction (advance_materialized_grant_version in workers/effective_birthright.rs, the repository activate path, application_access.rs). Only recertification omitted it, and recertification only fires when a grant reaches its recert due date.
incident.not_caused_by: The 2026-09-09 frontend v2 promotion. That changed templates and CSS only; the service ran healthy for about eleven hours after it and failed when the recert job came due.

code_fix.change: open_recertification() now advances grant_entitlement and grant_binding to the new version in the same transaction, matching every other version-bump path
code_fix.expiry_path_untouched: The expire/revoke transition bumps toward a terminal state where the grant is no longer live and readiness does not join it; it was deliberately left alone.

data_repair.projection_reset: dead -> pending (attempts 0, lease_generation+1) so the worker could re-drive it
data_repair.outcome: projected on the first attempt; policy_epoch 41, projected_edge_count 238 equal to binding rows at version, ack digest valid
data_repair.note: Recertification does not change what is granted, so the same 238 entitlements are correct at version 2. grt_platform_bootstrap_admin_v1..v6 carry the same version skew but are superseded grants that readiness does not join; they were left alone.

production_acceptance.analyze_facade: recovered to healthy once Access stopped returning 503

rollback.note: Rolling the image back reinstates the bug but not the data skew; the repaired rows stay correct.

not_claimed: The model-required full L2 acceptance suite was NOT run. Same model-free mode as 2026-09-06.

The repository's Postgres-backed tests could not be executed against a throwaway database: migrate() enforces a public-schema trust gate that a plain postgres:16-alpine does not satisfy, and the pre-existing tests fail there identically. The regression test is written and compiles but has not been executed against a real provisioned database.
follow_ups: newapi declares depends_on access-governance: service_healthy. While Access was unhealthy any restart of NewAPI would have hung; it survived only because it had been running for twelve days.
grt_platform_bootstrap_admin_v1..v6 still show grant.version 2 against materialized version 1. They are superseded and unused by readiness, but the skew is evidence the same path bumped them earlier.
Provision a test database that satisfies the migrate() schema-trust gate so the governance suite can actually run in CI.
